wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market News, Nov. 20, 2026: Tech Rout Deepens as Nvidia, Anthropic Slide
wsjHeadlines.description: Nasdaq tumbles 5.3%; Claude maker gives up most of its day-one gains after failing to soothe AI jitters

wsjHeadlines.title: Has the AI Bubble Already Burst?
wsjHeadlines.description: The AI selloff ravaging the stock market in recent weeks is remarkably like the bursting of the dot-com bubble.

wsjHeadlines.title: James Bond’s Bare Wrist Sets Off Watch Industry War
wsjHeadlines.description: 007 has worn an Omega watch for three decades, but the brand was missing from the big reveal.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Blame Game Has Begun Over Anthropic’s Turbulent Trading Debut
wsjHeadlines.description: The AI giant’s stock slid in its second day of trading, at one point dropping to just 5 cents above its IPO price.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic’s IPO Turmoil Caps $4 Trillion AI Wipeout on Wall Street
wsjHeadlines.description: A brutal selloff in stocks got worse as the week wore on, and not even the biggest IPO in history could slow it down.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nasdaq Turns Red For The Year
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Anthropic falls back and Treasury yields plunge

wsjHeadlines.title: Citi Undercounted $35 Billion in Assets at U.K. Subsidiary
wsjHeadlines.description: The record-keeping blunder, which was related to risk-weighted assets, is a setback for CEO Jane Fraser’s efforts to strengthen internal controls.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Shares Are a Rational Bet on the Next Phase of AI
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence boom’s profits today go mostly to picks and shovels, but that will shift.

wsjHeadlines.title: Is Anthropic Worth $2 Trillion, or $1.5 Trillion? How to Make Sense of the Valuations
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s complex structure and funding make for confusing valuation math.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia’s Strong Fundamentals Give New CEO a Much-Needed Tailwind
wsjHeadlines.description: The company inherits problems from Jensen Huang, and advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: Why Big Investors Are Burning Lenders on Apartment Loans
wsjHeadlines.description: Deep-pocketed landlords like Brookfield may be the most willing to cut their losses on troubled properties.

wsjHeadlines.title: Big Tech Needs to Spread Its Bets on Data Centers
wsjHeadlines.description: Artificial-intelligence players that bet too much on a handful of mega projects look vulnerable after the midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: British Bank Backed by Kushner’s Affinity Gets U.S. License
wsjHeadlines.description: OakNorth looks across the Atlantic to lend more to growing companies.

wsjHeadlines.title: Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data Leaked by Hackers
wsjHeadlines.description: The incident involved data belonging to thousands of customers, but it isn’t disrupting payment services or connected to banking issues earlier this week.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pledged to Mobilize $500 Billion for Nvidia—but Hasn’t Put Up a Dime
wsjHeadlines.description: A wave of money that was supposed to help customers keep buying Nvidia chips hasn’t materialized.

wsjHeadlines.title: JPMorgan Chase Names Bregje de Best to Succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO
wsjHeadlines.description: De Best joined JPMorgan in 2006 and has been finance chief of its commercial and investment bank since June 2025.

wsjHeadlines.title: Deutsche Bank Shares Drop After Leaks Put Spotlight on Troubled Past
wsjHeadlines.description: A media consortium reported on failings in the bank’s handling of high-risk customers, including Russian oligarchs and Jeffrey Epstein.

wsjHeadlines.title: What It’s Like to Retire in Thailand
wsjHeadlines.description: It’s hot, humid and costs a bit more than we anticipated. But we love the life we’ve built here.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Sanofi, Insmed, Novartis and more in the latest Market Talks covering he health care sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Data Centers Are the Growth Engine of America’s Power Grid
wsjHeadlines.description: Some of the best analysis and insight on investing, the wealth-management business and more.

wsjHeadlines.title: Grabbing Inflation Protection Now Is a No-Brainer
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, the AI trade keeps deflating despite Anthropic’s strong debut.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Lives Up to Wall Street Hype, but AI Doubts Linger
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Kushner floats a Ukraine peace deal that would upend U.S. policy, and the snack sailors aboard the USS George Washington can’t get enough of.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Extend Plunge as AI Boom Turns to Bust
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks plunged and an index of mega-cap technology stocks skirted bear-market territory as predictions of a speculative bust in artificial-intelligence stocks appeared to come to fruition.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech Rout Deepens as Anthropic Stock Slides
wsjHeadlines.description: The selloff in technology stocks intensified, dragging the S&P 500 and Dow industrials into correction territory.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Tech Stocks Tumble as AI Selloff Intensifies
wsjHeadlines.description: European AI stocks dropped sharply as a global selloff intensified.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Equities Tumble as AI Stock Selloff Deepens
wsjHeadlines.description: Asian equities fell Friday morning as Anthropic’s blockbuster initial public offering failed to staunch the selloff in artificial intelligence stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic’s Mega IPO Lives Up to Wall Street Hype but Fails to Revive AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors remained wary of tech and AI stocks, as the Nasdaq composite resumed its recent slide, dropping 2.3% on Thursday.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Give Thanks to Inverse Billionaires
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech leaders capture only 4% of the wealth they create. Everyone else splits the rest.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Why China Wants to Control a Yacht Maker
wsjHeadlines.description: The story of Italy’s Ferretti Group points to a vulnerability in the West’s system to control investment by foreign adversaries.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Astonishing Wealth of Anthropic
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors weren’t fazed by doubts about AI after the Nvidia tumult.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Last Week’s Outages Were Only the Start
wsjHeadlines.description: With AI’s power growing faster than we can keep up, we can expect a difficult two to three years.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Guess Who’s Coming to Mecca
wsjHeadlines.description: The hajj increasingly draws worshippers from South and Southeast Asia.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Congrats on Your Anthropic Shares
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s IPO will benefit taxpayers and workers far and wide.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Post Weekly Losses on Rising Middle East Supply
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude futures fell for a third straight week as increasing supply out of the Middle East outweighed concerns about continuing strikes across the region.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Rise With Support From LNG Exports
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures recovered from the previous day’s losses and settled at the highest level since early February.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Fall for Third Straight Week on Supply Outlook
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures settled higher Friday, but ended the week with losses as the market assessed improving global supply conditions amid continued threats to Middle Eastern oil shipments.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Falls to Nearly 15-Month Low On Interest-Rate Expectations
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures fell to their lowest level since late August of 2025 as the rout continued amid concerns that the Fed will continue raising interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold, Silver Drop to Lowest Levels in Over a Year
wsjHeadlines.description: Expectations for tighter monetary policy appear to have overshadowed the typical demand for gold as a safe haven for risk-averse investors.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.42% This Week to 98.75
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index declined 0.1%, snapping a two-trading-day winning streak.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises to New 52-Week High
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose to a new 52-week high.
